en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear: reads as a 20th-century anti-fascist song but I cannot name an author. 'носат роса' (line 3) is my reading as 'carried, dewy'; 'Мокришко' is presumably a place name.

lines.en: (The village of Vataša began to weep)
The village began to weep, the village of Vataša,
the village began to weep, the village of Vataša,
thirteen young men are carried, dewy,
through the Mokrishko woods, into the valleys.

lines.cyr: Целото село станало, станало на нога,
lines.lat: Celoto selo stanalo, stanalo na noga,
lines.en: The whole village stood up, stood on its feet,

lines.cyr: целото село станало, станало на нога:
lines.lat: celoto selo stanalo, stanalo na noga:
lines.en: the whole village stood up, stood on its feet:
- Give our children here to us,

lines.cyr: Џелати клети не слушаат, не слушаат народот,
lines.lat: Dželati kleti ne slušaat, ne slušaat narodot,
lines.en: The cursed executioners do not listen, do not listen to the people,

lines.cyr: џелати клети не слушаат, не слушаат народот,
lines.lat: dželati kleti ne slušaat, ne slušaat narodot,
lines.en: the cursed executioners do not listen, do not listen to the people,
the filthy machine gun spat fire

lines.cyr: Тогај се народ подигна, подигна илјадно,
lines.lat: Togaj se narod podigna, podigna iljadno,
lines.en: Then the people rose up, rose up in their thousands,

lines.cyr: и тргна смело да запре семе
